fixed_implementation_assumptions.bearing_layout: Long front bearing ends at first row+24.5mm and extends115mm toward nose. Other bearing centers use inherited rows. Crank bays centered between rows.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.dowel_axial_positions: Long bearing midpoint; short bearings72percent along span. Positions unprinted, chosen to separate oil entry and locating hole.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.bearing_oil_features: Front entries at25/75percent length; short entry atmidpoint. Front running-face grooves are rounded cross channels at±45degrees, span20percent oflongbearing length and widthcontrol3mm. Short pocketspan40percent ofshortbearing length and widthtwicegroovewidth. Constant radialdepth0.6mm. Upper-shell machining mirrors the lower as an assumption. Joint notches2mm axial width,4mm total height, oneper roughly10mm length. Outer front housing grooves3mm wide; axial seat leads radius1.5mm. All these sizes are estimated.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.case_oil_feeds: Lower radial machining extends70mm from shaftaxis to the existing web cavity. Pressure pipes and full lead routing pending.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.thrust_internal_fits: Central race bore journal radius+0.1mm; sleeve radial allowance uses thrust_seat_gap. Housing end walls3mm. Retaining-nut flange4mm axial stock and castellations3mm axial depth. Unprinted fits/stocks.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.key_and_screw: Slot0.1mm wider than key and0.05mm longer at each end. Rounded endradius halfwidth. Extraction holes atkeycenter±onequarterlength. Screw bore/head radius allowance0.05mm and tip overrun0.1mm. Driver slot1.2mm wide and nominal0.7mm deep; thread envelopes unhelical.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.output_cotter_form: Leg center spacing0.52diameter; head/exit gaps0.8mm; bendradius3mm/35deg; eyeradius4mm/rise2mm. Eye lead overlap0.03mm is construction allowance. Eye shape and bends approximate;source leglength retained.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.output_cotter_axial_position: 3.5mm inward from free end of the24mm estimated threaded extension. Hole radial allowance0.1mm.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.numerical_cutting_extensions: Oversized boolean cutters extend beyond target surfaces, commonly1mm. These tool overruns are construction devices, not added physical stock or source dimensions.
fixed_implementation_assumptions.simplifications: Forging fillets and helical threads are omitted; oil groove profiles approximate. Bearing liners are represented in one physical composite shell per catalogue half rather than separate manufactured pieces.
